title: Iran Crisis Report Data Configuration
description: Schema for data.json - central configuration for date, statistics, scenario percentages, and ticker headlines

gaTrackingId.description: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID (e.g., 'G-XXXXXXXXXX'). Replace with your real tracking ID.

date.description: Display date in format 'Month DD, YYYY' (e.g., 'February 27, 2026')

lastUpdated.description: Last update timestamp in format 'HH:MM UTC' (e.g., '19:44 UTC')

statUsTroopsSource.description: Source for US troops count (e.g., 'Task & Purpose')

statMissilesFiredSource.description: Source for missiles fired count (e.g., 'Crit. Threats')

statOilAtRisk.description: Oil barrels per day at risk through Hormuz (e.g., '20M')

statIrgcKilled.description: Iranian military and IRGC personnel killed (e.g., '555+')

statUsCasualties.description: US service members killed in action (e.g., '6')

scenarioDealPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Diplomatic Deal scenario (eliminated — keep at 0)

scenarioStrikesPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Military Strikes (standalone) scenario (in progress / excluded from sum — keep at 0)

scenarioRevolutionPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Scenario 1: Regime Collapse / Revolution (0-100)

scenarioPahlaviPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Scenario 2: Pahlavi Returns — Democratic Transition (0-100)

scenarioFrozenPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Prolonged Standoff / Frozen Conflict scenario (eliminated — keep at 0)

scenarioJuntaPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Scenario 3: IRGC Junta — Succession Council (0-100)

scenarioCivilWarPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Scenario 4: Iranian Civil War / State Fragmentation (0-100)

scenarioRegionalEscalationPct.description: Likelihood percentage for Scenario 5: Regional Escalation / Proxy War Spread (0-100)

ticker.description: Breaking news headlines for scrolling ticker (automatically duplicated by build script)

items.description: Single ticker headline (no need to duplicate - build script handles this)

dayToday.description: Auto-generated by build.js from date field (e.g., 'FEB 27')

dayYesterday.description: Auto-generated by build.js from date field (e.g., 'FEB 26')

dayTwoDaysAgo.description: Auto-generated by build.js from date field (e.g., 'FEB 25')

dateShort.description: Auto-generated by build.js from date field (e.g., 'Feb 28, 2026')

mapEvents.description: Dynamic map events added by AI pipeline (overlaid on static markers.geojson)
